text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My third summer camp with Narita Taishin has begun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other runners—with whom Narita Taishin spent the last summer camp—drop by to invite her to train and hang out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Narita Taishin is a little unsure, she's open to the idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears this summer camp will be a fun one.
